Done! Added `addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })` and `removeLine(invoice, sku)` with 11 new tests. All 40 tests pass ✓

- `addLine` adds a new line or increases qty if SKU exists; validates qty and SKU; rejects non-draft invoices
- `removeLine` removes a line by SKU; prevents removing the last line; rejects non-draft invoices
- Both preserve immutability and share the same error codes as createInvoice plus NOT_DRAFT and LINE_NOT_FOUND
